description: Comprehensive skill for the author's single-GPU passthrough setup: Fedora 44 bootc atomic host with Intel i5-12400F, NVIDIA RTX 2060 12GB (TU106), QEMU 10.2.2, libvirt 12.0.0, Wayland (niri on greetd). Covers hook scripts, kernel config, libvirt domain XML, virsh operations, and troubleshooting for single-GPU VFIO passthrough to a Win10 VM.
